name: Ribbon swoosh reveal
what: A thick ribbon swoops across the screen along a wave, carrying three words and five round pictures that ride away with it; the wave flattens into a band that opens into a wide horn, and your name's letters flicker in on it.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f3-f26 the ribbon head sweeps across (drawn along a wave) while the whole wave slides left from f12 (fastest at f36, stopping by f99); the three words and the round pictures are fixed to the wave (each fades or grows in as the ribbon reaches it); f50-f99 the wave flattens into a straight band whose end rests at 27 % of the width; f100-f138 the band opens into a horn that grows right (accelerating) and fills the right side; f122-f158 the name's letters flicker in; then it holds to f210
